Brother KH-970 CB-1  —  built-in stitch-pattern atlas
======================================================

Descriptor table : ROM 0x50000..0x51FFC (bank 5), 12 bytes/record, searched downward.
Record layout     : [0]type [1]0 [2..3]BCD-catalog [4..5]BCD-width [6..7]BCD-height
                    [8]0 [9]bank [10..11]offset
Data layout       : [0..ceil(H/2)) row-code nibbles (1 per row);
                    [ceil(H/2)..) row-major 1bpp bitmap, stride = ceil(W/8).
Row-code nibble   : context-dependent — 0 = knit (non-lace) / lace transfer (lace);
                    2 = knit carriage in lace; 10/11 = fine-lace transfer rows.
Type 0x02 = 1bpp bitmap (display height = H).
Type 0x03 = 3 interleaved 1bpp planes (display height = H/3), catalog 479-483 only.
Each preview row is prefixed with its row-code value (e.g. " 2|...."; see the key per section).
Full resolution: every data row and every stitch column is shown.

Library: catalog 1-498 (15 user categories) + 499-885 (bank-7 extras).
